_comment: Written by the daily run. ideas: proposed briefs. watchlist: promising but under-evidenced. rejected: looked at seriously and dropped. Incumbents are App Store app ids.

ideas.title: Fifty Hours (working name)
ideas.evidence: RoadReady (2.9, 19k ratings): 87 low-star reviews in 90d, 128 since May 2026, us only, rising monthly after the June rewrite: login 51, lost hours 27, ads 14. RoadReady Ohio 6 in 90d and Aceable's log 2 share the complaint

watchlist.evidence: Untappd 5.0 redesign (2026-10-15): 87 low-star reviews on v5.0.x 2026-10-16..10-31 (us 66, gb 21; only 1 low-star in the 2 months before), themes UI clutter 48, friends feed 17, own history/tracking 12, ads 10, Insider paywall 7 (Untappd 216k ratings us, grossing in 2). Vivino 2026.33-2026.43 rebuild: ~15 of 25 low-star reviews (us, gb, 2026-08-13..10-30) about personal logging getting worse: can't edit wine/year, no manual entry, tasted wines lost, cellar notes removed (Vivino 140k ratings us). Competitors are tiny or single-drink: Bruwia (free, beer, imports Untappd history), Vinocell ($9.99, wine cellar, 1.8k), CellarTracker (650), Beerstory/Tastings/BrewGene/Pint Please (0-75 ratings). Untappd check-in export is Insider-only (GDPR request in the EU). 2026-11-03 rescan: Untappd 91 low-star in 90d (us 69, gb 22), now on 5.0.2, still 2-6 a day at month end; Vivino 26 (us 20, gb 6), still on 2026.42-43. 2026-11-04 rescan: Untappd 92 low-star in 90d (us 70, gb 28 all-time stored), still 1-6 a day to 11-01, 1 in November so far; Vivino 27. 2026-11-05 daily data: Untappd 92 in 90d, 13 since 10-28 on v5.0.x, us 70 and gb 28 stored; Vivino 27, now on 2026.43+; no new storefronts
watchlist.promote_if: the Untappd/Vivino complaints are still coming 4+ weeks on (after Untappd 5.1 and the next Vivino release), appear in ≥3 more storefronts, ≥3 independent off-store threads show people leaving for a private log, and there's evidence of willingness to pay (asks for a one-time paid journal, or Insider/Premium cancellations citing logging). Otherwise reject: drinkers are used to free apps, and Bruwia already imports Untappd history for free

watchlist.evidence: Timehop (186k ratings, ~12M installs, 74% ad revenue per AppGoblin): 43 low-star reviews in 90d, 70 in 12 months (us, gb), rising since v5.0 (2026-07), from 8-12 year users with long streaks: unskippable ads, camera-roll photos stuck at 0%, memories and streaks moved behind Timehop+. Competitors are on-device and tiny: Photo Flashback (free, 4.9, 256 ratings), On This Day Rewind ($4.99 one-time, streaks, widgets, MacStories review, 8 ratings), Ayer, Latent, Tiny Whale, ThenNow, Photura, Memozie, ChronoPics. About 14 clones, none with traction. 2026-11-04 rescan: 44 in 90d (22 in the last 30); no off-store threads of people leaving found. 2026-11-05 daily data: 43 in 90d, 4 since 10-28, no update since 2026-10-01
watchlist.promote_if: a differentiator the clones lack, shown on the first screen (e.g. a real daily-streak ritual with streak carry-over that long-time users respond to), off-store threads of people leaving, and explicit willingness to pay; most reviewers are angry about paying at all

watchlist.evidence: Vehicle Maintenance Tracker (4.3, 2.9k ratings): 40 of 40 low-star reviews in 90d are about lost or unreliable records (us 39, gb 1), 87 since June 2026 (Jun 6, Jul 37, Aug 22, Sep 12, Oct 9): service dates reset to 01/01/1900 after the May redesign, no release since 2026-06-27, at least 13 reviewers leaving for other apps, paper or Excel. CARFAX Car Care (4.8, 128k): 7 in 90d (3 lost records, 4 forced logouts), 12 since February across v4.11-5.9. Fuelly (4.7, ~30k, Finance genre, not scannable): no update since 2024-06-03. Passes Gate A on reviews (47 in 90d, 2 apps). Competition is the problem: about 25 small logs; Car Cave (4.7, 376, no login, iCloud, Premium $4.99, a VMT reviewer moved to it and praised it), My Car (4.7, 1.2k), Drivvo (982), Road Trip MPG (629), and all-machine local logs Kelvik, MaintainAll, Maintenance Tracker, Recur.it, Loggy (88) already make the same pitch. LookOver (4.9, 5,000+ downloads by its own count, free for one machine, $24.99/yr) already tracks mowers, generators and powersports by engine hours. Only 6 VMT reviews since Nov 2025 mention non-car machines
watchlist.promote_if: a differentiator the small logs lack, shown on the first screen (all machines plus local backup isn't one: Kelvik, MaintainAll and LookOver already offer it, and Car Cave covers cars well); confirmation that VMT and Fuelly CSV exports import with dates intact; Fuelly's reviews measured (needs the Finance-genre exclusion relaxed for named targets); ≥3 dated off-store threads in the last 12 months

rejected.reason: fix already crowded (TrialGuard, Trial Alert, TrialHero, Bobby, ReSubs); no subscription API on iOS; finance-adjacent; 4.3 risk high
LocalSend already free, open-source, ad-free
AI inference cost drives the ads; fails Gate B economics; evidence mostly one storefront
background removal built into iOS; rest is billing disputes
needs caller/spam database and Call Directory extension
two-sided dating marketplace; fails Gate B
licensed content; fails Gate B
review scan found no recent complaints; paid charts only in tiny storefronts; generic workout category, high 4.3 risk
only 5 low-star reviews in 90d; crowded with Anki-compatible apps (AnkiApp, Noji, RemNote)
dropbox.com web already lets over-quota users get files out; API-dependent one-off export, no recurring value

~125 low-star reviews (sa, us, ae, gb, pk, my) on immodest ads while reading; killed by free ad-free Quran.com app (4.9, 33.9k), iQuran (4.8, 30.9k, no ads/no subs), Greentech Al Quran (4.8, 19.1k); 4.3 risk high
~51 low-star reviews on ads blocking prayer times/adhan; killed by Pillars (4.8, 5.6k, free, no ads), MAWAQIT (4.9, 6.3k), Pray Watch (4.8, 9.3k), iPray ($1.99, 4.8, 9k)
VN (4.8, 323k, free, no watermark) and InShot already fill it; video editor not a 14-day build
redesign backlash (~20 reviews); drawing engine not feasible in Expo/14 days

14 low-star reviews, 7 apps (sa, ae, ca, us, gb, my) on paying for prayer times/adhan/reciters/widgets; killed by fully free ad-free MAWAQIT (4.9, 6.3k), Pray Watch (4.8, 9.3k), IslamApp (4.9, 6.0k), Quran.com (4.9, 33.9k), iQuran (4.8, 30.9k)
15 reviews of lifetime/one-time buyers re-charged or unable to restore; billing dispute, and iPray ($1.99 one-time, 4.8, 9.1k) plus free apps already serve one-time buyers
~13-16 reviews of missed adhan/wrong times since Athan Pro 9.0 + iOS 27 (Sept 2026); incumbent regression, and MAWAQIT, Pray Watch, iPray already reliable
10 reviews (lost bookmarks/position, Quran Pro 6 redesign, Ayah removed Ibn Kathir/Sa'di tafsir); Quran.com and iQuran already do this free; tafsir is licensed
~9 low-star reviews, one storefront (in), on basic edits paywalled at save time; fails Gate A; Snapseed free/ad-free already covers it; full photo editor not a 14-day build

~15 relevant reviews, still one app (targeted rescan of SCRL + 9 carousel competitors 2026-11-01 got 0 reviews); SwipeMix (4.8, 6k) already sells one-time packs, Seam is free/ad-supported, ~10 other splitters (Panoslice, SWVY, Crsel, FlowGrid, Unfurl, InstaSlide); the 'needs IG professional account' pain disappears with any save-to-camera-roll splitter; high 4.3 risk

43 low-star reviews (us, gb, hr, rs) on an ad every 2-3 letters and $15/week to use your handwriting font; fails Gate B: iOS keyboards can only insert Unicode text, so a custom font can't be typed into Messages/WhatsApp (reviewers say Fontmaker's doesn't work either); mostly young users
9 reviews on $9.99/week for a Bible + widget; YouVersion Bible (4.9, 178k, free) and many free KJV/verse-of-the-day apps already do it
7 reviews (us) wanting Instagram/Facebook import and photo-of-handwritten-recipe; ReciMe (4.8, 324k) already does social import and scanning; fails Gate A
tracing-projector apps are a clone category (dozens of AR tracing apps, mostly weekly subs) and free ones exist; a cheaper copy is a 4.3 risk; targeted scan returned no reviews
83 low-star reviews on a paywalled result after the photo; needs face matching against celebrity images (AI + image rights); fails Gate B
18 reviews on forced rating prompts, manual one-by-one cleaning and trial charges; photo-cleaner category is crowded (Cleanup 750k ratings) and the pain is dark patterns, not a missing workflow
32 reviews (us, de, au) on tracking gaps since iOS 27 and dropped old watches; watchOS + deep HealthKit, fails Gate B
18 reviews (gb) on battery drain since v26.41 plus price; a recent regression, and reliable alarms need native AlarmKit work, fails Gate B

Gate A passes across 2 apps: VSCO ~13 reviews (us, gb, ar) on free tools moved to Pro, plus Esti ~12 (us) on 'pay for everything' and AI-filter credits. Killed by Dazz Cam (4.8, 103k ratings, film looks with a $19.99 one-time Pro) and Snapseed (free, no account); VSCO's paywall moves date back to 2022; crowded filter category, 4.3 risk

17 low-star reviews in 90d (gb only) from shoppers sent by merchants to an app charging £10/week to track one parcel; AfterShip (4.7, 333k, free tracking) and 17TRACK already do it free, and carrier data needs a paid tracking API (fails Gate B)

72 low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb) about AI-made, inaccurate patterns and nearly every pattern being Pro-only; the fix is a pattern library (content you can't license or produce in 14 days, fails Gate B), and Ravelry/YouTube already give free patterns

50 + 20 low-star reviews (us, gb) from people sent to look-alike authenticator apps charging $9.99/week; free Google/Microsoft Authenticator and the built-in iOS Passwords codes already do it, so there is no gap to build into

143 low-star reviews in 90d (gb, us, ca, au), ~50 about being forced into a trial of a 'free' recipe saver; killed by a crowded field: Mela+ ($6.99 one-time) reads Instagram/TikTok/YouTube descriptions, Recipe Keeper ($19.99 one-time), Paprika ($4.99), plus free tiers of Peel, Recipe Notes, Flavorish; video import needs AI; high 4.3 risk
76 low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb); no update since 2025-07 and trimmed recordings can't be saved for ~a year; Apple Voice Memos is free and built in, with trimming and transcription

45 low-star reviews in 90d (us) about the free tier losing radar and storm tracks after the 2026 redesign; free radar is already in Apple Weather and MyRadar, and radar data beyond US NEXRAD needs licensing

33 low-star reviews in 90d across Pillars (14; us, gb, ae) and Niyat (19; us, au, ca) about a long unskippable onboarding survey ending in a paywall before basic prayer/Quran features; same kill as paywall:islamic-apps:basic-worship-features: MAWAQIT, Quran.com, Pray Watch and IslamApp are free and ad-free with no survey

110 low-star reviews in 90d (us) about the price going from ~$99 to ~$250/yr and the free tier shrinking; notes apps are a crowded category (Apple Notes free, UpNote lifetime, Obsidian, Bear), so a cheaper notes app is a 4.3 risk with no clear gap

14 low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb; several in Spanish) about push alerts being Pro-only and arriving late; under Gate A volume, and free MyShake, LastQuake (EMSC) and Earthquake Network already send alerts; real early warning needs a sensor network

91 low-star reviews in 90d (us 77, gb 14) since StrongLifts went subscription-only (free tier and lifetime Power Pack dropped, $59.99/yr), plus a disliked 4.4 watch/UI redesign; the strongest pain of the day, but killed: Lift5x5 (free core 5x5 with auto-progression, imports StrongLifts CSV, lifetime option), 5x5 Workout Lifting Tracker ($9.99 one-time, watch), 5x5 Workout by Zen Labs (4.7, 1.6k, $8.99 Pro) and other 2025-26 clones already do it, so another 'same but one-time' 5x5 app is a 4.3 risk; watch logging (much loved) is out of Expo scope

Liftoff (39), Fitbod (36), Gymverse (20) low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb) about being forced into a subscription after onboarding; Hevy (4.9, 101k ratings) logs unlimited workouts free, so a generic logger has no gap
30 low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb) about unskippable full-screen ads; Apple Podcasts is free and built in, and Pocket Casts/Overcast have free ad-light tiers

Bose ended the SoundTouch cloud on 2026-05-06: 91 low-star reviews in 2026 (us, gb), 18 in the last 90d and falling, presets and internet radio gone. Bose published the local API, and the gap is already filled: free open-source SoundTouch Reborn (installs on the speaker, restores buttons, radio, Spotify, multiroom), Better ST (⋆4.8, 49 ratings, £6.99, #1 paid Music in be), Bosman (4.5, 39), Mast ($1.99), ST Remote Pro. A fifth controller for a shrinking installed base fails Gate B on 4.3 risk, and needs the hardware to test

75 low-star reviews in 90d (us 68, gb 7) from long-time users losing free sounds and mixes to a ~$70/yr subscription; White Noise is $0.99 one-time (⋆4.8, 46k), iOS Background Sounds are free and built in, and sound mixers are a crowded category
46 stored low-star reviews, ~35 in 90d (us, gb), on ads covering the keypad and $24.99/yr; a template category with a high 4.3 risk, and the iOS Calculator has converted units since iOS 18
~30 low-star reviews in 90d (us) on unskippable ads in DC Metro and Bus; one-city audience, and Citymapper, Transit and Apple Maps cover DC for free

22 low-star reviews in 90d (gb 16, us 6) on ads after every tap in a cute study timer; focus timers are a crowded template category (Forest, Flora, Focus Friend), and the audience is students who rarely pay

targeted scan: PetrolPrices (7 low-star), Lanetalk (10), Rec-all (0), Hours Tracker (4), Melodista (0) had no recurring pain; Musicana (19) is an abandoned streaming player whose songs stopped playing (grey-area content); Fitbit to Apple Health Sync (35) is mostly Google Health migration anger aimed at the wrong app
round 2 scan: Forma 6, Speed Tracker 2, Clay 1, Fitness App 1, PDF Scanner Pro 0 low-star in 90d; nothing recurring

Avenza Maps (128k ratings): ~70 low-star reviews since May 2026, 23 in 90d, us only, after the Blue Marble merger put custom GeoPDF import behind $35-50/yr Plus (20 imports) and ~$170 Pro and froze the map store. Strong pain but killed: Topo Maps+ (4.7, 9.4k ratings) lets free users import up to 10 GeoPDFs; ArcGIS Field Maps (free, no sign-in, GeoPDF since 2026-03) is what wildfire incident pages now point to; MapNero has no import limit even free; ArkenMap $3.99 one-time; NomadTracks free; plus MapCheck, Mapio, FO Maps

Hurricane Tracker (45k ratings): 68 low-star reviews since July 2026 (28 in October, us) after a redesign and forced subscription, one-time buyers locked out; NHC data is public, but National Hurricane Center Data (4.8, 76k, free) and My Hurricane Tracker Pro (4.8, 5.8k, $3.99 one-time) already fill it

The Wonder Weeks (122k ratings): 25 low-star in 90d (us, gb), ~10 in the days after v14.0 (2026-10-28) moved one-time buyers to $5/month; the leap framework is the publisher's proprietary content, reviewers also call it inaccurate, and clones already exist (Baby Leaps $6.99/yr, LittleLeaps, Baby Tracker: Leaps & Weeks); fails Gate B on content rights

Photo Widget. (2.5k ratings): 49 low-star in 90d (us, gb) on a new watermark, ads and ~$12/yr to remove it; the widget is the whole product, so native extension work is the core and fails Gate B; a reviewer already moved to a $9.99 lifetime photo widget app

round 1 scan: Countdown App (28; a horror-film novelty, not a tool), Bible Gateway (22; ads, YouVersion free), Magic Poser (43; 3D posing engine), VLC (37; bugs), Airmail (34; mail client), RadarScope (15), Photo Recovery (57; trial traps), Planning Center (12; a church's own system); nothing small and recurring

Timer Plus (61k ratings): 131 low-star reviews in the last 30 days (us 86, gb 51 stored), nearly all since 2026-10-28, when a free interval timer put a hard paywall (~$20) in front of Start and the paid build then crashed on launch on iOS 27; Seconds (24k) got 31 in 90d after its v26 redesign. Biggest paywall surge of the day, but killed: Seconds Pro ($7.99 one-time, 4.8, 12k), Tabata Timer and HIIT Timer (4.8, 73.7k, free to download), SmartWOD Timer (4.9, 54k, free to download), Tabata Timer: Interval Timer (4.9, 9.5k, free to download), plus a wave of new 2026 timers; template category with high 4.3 risk

Alarm Clock HD (104k ratings): 35 low-star in 90d (us), 26 on unskippable ads, from 10-15 year users; reliable alarms need native AlarmKit work (same Gate B failure as bugs:alarmy:battery-drain), and the iOS Clock is free

Fishbrain (76k ratings): 41 low-star in 90d (us), 25 on nearly everything needing ~$80/yr Pro; the value is its catch data and community, a two-sided network a new app can't copy (Fishing Points 4.7, 31k has 3 low-star)

round 2 vertical scan: Fabulous (138; billing disputes), RV LIFE (55; buggy trip planner on routing data), TimeTree (36; mostly jp UI complaints), Songsterr (26) and Oxford Dictionary (24; licensed content), Ride with GPS (21), iCollect (20; ~$100 unlock, 10 relevant, one app), BIGVU (26) and PromptSmart (18; bugs), Trailforks (17), AllStays (17); nothing passed Gate A with a buildable fix. Quiet: Sortly 0, knitCompanion 0, TonalEnergy 2, Strides 2, Days Since 2, Reading List 4, LogTen 4, UDisc 5, FarOut 6

Withings (369k ratings): 128 low-star reviews in 90d, 125 of them since 2026-10-13 (us 81, gb 56 stored), 64 naming Apple Health, after accounts created from 10-13 need Withings+ ($99.50/yr) for automatic sync. Heavy press and a 200+ comment support thread, no reversal. Fails Gate B: the same rule covers the free API plan (Partner Hub, from 10-12) and the terms bar routing data around it, so a sync bridge can't get the data; the only free route is manual CSV export, and Health CSV Importer (4.2, 292, free for weight) already takes that. Recheck if Withings reverses or Apple acts on guideline 4.10

Swipewipe (100k ratings): 103 low-star in 90d, 83 in the last 30 (us, gb), ads every two minutes and a paywall; Slidebox (4.8, 16.7k, free) does the same swipe-to-sort, and photo cleaners are a crowded template category with a high 4.3 risk

Discogs (67k ratings): 31 low-star in 90d (us, gb), about 11 on forced logouts and password resets, 8 on collection sort resets, 7 on a broken video player, 3 on an upsell sheet; mostly bugs, and VinylBox ($0.99-1.99/mo, Discogs sync) and iCollect Music (4.5, 2.5k) already cover the collection

TouchRetouch (58k ratings): 25 low-star in 90d (us, gb) from one-time buyers now asked for $15-30/yr to save; object removal is built into iOS Photos (Clean Up) and Snapseed is free, and inpainting isn't a 14-day build

round 3 scan of recently updated tools: Facts (46; trial and content), Layout (37; save paywall, crowded collage category), SongShift (31; TuneMyMusic free, needs streaming APIs), Collectr (28; price accuracy, needs market data), Tiimo (28; review prompts), Find Air (20; $9.99/week fleeceware), Evermusic (16); nothing passed. Quiet: mSecure 0, Device Tracker 0, Geocaching 1, Happy Scale 1, magicplan 1, Moon Phase apps 1-2, Countdown 7, Waterllama 10
TV Time shut down on 2026-07-15 (free-only model), but ithinkdiff lists 10 replacements with imports, among them Trakt, Simkl (free), Showly ($14.99 lifetime) and Sofa Time ($9.99 lifetime). Filled

Simply Draw (139k ratings): 91 low-star in 90d, 85 in 30 (us, gb), v1.20.0: one free drawing, then ~$100/yr. Reviewers are mostly children and an original lesson library is a content build, not 14 days. YouTube is free
Lapse (3.7k ratings): 46 low-star since its pivot, friends feed removed and old photos deleted. The loved part was social, which fails Gate B
HotSchedules (67k ratings): 69 low-star since v6.0 on 2026-09-10, shift swaps and store logs broken. Staff use whatever their employer buys, so it's a B2B platform sale, not a 14-day consumer app
Home Design 3D (105k ratings): 31 low-star in 90d, Gold Edition one-time buyers moved to a paid tier. A 3D floor-plan editor with an item catalog doesn't fit 14 days
AccuWeather (98k ratings): 96 low-star in 90d, 80 in 30, slow loads, ads and notifications after v21. Crowded category; Apple Weather is free

Goodreads (34, Amazon ads after v4.37; StoryGraph and Fable exist, its value is the network), Joist (8), iNavX (0), GuitarTuna (28; trial billing, free tuners abound), Welltory (48; billing), Flighty (30; review prompts), MapQuest (28; routing), VLLO (19; AI update), e-Diyanet (38; a location bug in a Turkish state app)

round 3 scan of non-charting log and tool apps: Planner 5D (93; 3D, billing), Home Planner AI (26; 3D), Planta (21; plant ID is AI and there are many rivals), Golfshot (18), 18Birdies (17) and Hole19 (10) need course data, Bookly (9), Habit Tracker (34; ads, generic category), Good Food (25; licensed recipes). Quiet: Reading List, Stop Motion Studio Pro, Ravit, BookBuddy Pro, Tunable, Typic, Universalis, Cloud Baby Monitor, FishTrack, Units Plus, 7 Minute Workout Challenge

Case Tracker for USCIS & NVC (319k ratings): 56 low-star in 90d (us), 28 on ads or Pro not unlocking, nearly all since v11.27. Killed: Lawfully (4.8, 174k) and tip-funded trackers like U.S. Immigration Case Tracker already exist, and the USCIS Case Status API needs an approved production demo and is described for customers and representatives, so the data can't be counted on in 14 days

FAX from iPhone (379k) 35 low-star and FaxFree (175k) 33, us: 'free' fax apps that bill about $9/week at the send step. Killed: Genius Fax (4.9, 44k) already sells $0.99 per-page credits with no subscription needed to send, every page costs a carrier fee so there is no useful free tier, and Gate B wants one pro entitlement, not consumables

10 universal remote apps: ~280 paywall complaints in 90d (us, gb). Largest cross-app paywall cluster today, but killed: Roku, Samsung SmartThings, LG ThinQ, Google TV and Fire TV all have free official remotes, each brand needs its own LAN protocol, and it's a template category with high 4.3 risk

Hilal Calendar (16k ratings): 17 low-star in 90d, sa only, about 10 on ads, plus lost lifetime purchases. Below Gate A: one storefront, one app. Many other Hijri calendars exist and a reviewer already moved to the official Umm al-Qura app (KACST), and iOS shows the Islamic calendar natively
NYT Cooking (549k ratings): 44 low-star in 60d (us), ~19 on an AI feature you can't turn off since v4.171. Subscribers pay for the recipe library, which can't be replaced

Scanner Pro (338k ratings): 35 low-star in 60d after v9.0 broke saving and pushed a subscription on one-time buyers. Killed: Notes and Files scan free, and Genius Scan and Adobe Scan are free; template category

Vocabulary (222k ratings): 67 low-star in 90d (us, gb), only 14 on AI-made or wrong definitions; the rest is billing. Its core is the home-screen widget, which needs native extension work, and free dictionary word-of-the-day apps exist

MarineTraffic (65k ratings): 87 low-star in 90d (us, gb) on the new app and paywall, with explicit willingness to pay for the old one. Vessel positions are AIS data you can't get for free; fails Gate B

term scan of non-charting logs (pilot, dive, hours, shift, chore, coins, wine cellar, hunting): nothing. Hours Tracker 11 low-star, When I Work 10, NurseGrid 7, Punch Time Clock 6, ForeFlight 6, Oceanic+ 12 (watch app); shift calendars (Spark, FireSync, Supershift, My Shift Planner) have 0-3

Forest (50k us ratings): 123 low-star in 90d (us 73, gb 49), Aug 5, Sep 46, Oct 66, 103 on the redesign since v5.26: 3-5 taps and animations to restart a timer, favourites and the time ring gone, one-time Pro retired for Plus at $5.99/mo or $35.99/yr. Biggest regression of the day, and Gate A passes. Killed: Flora (4.8, 85k ratings, free, only 6 low-star in 90d) already does the job and Forest reviewers name it; Focus Friend, FocusFlight, Focus Keeper, Focus Tree and Pomodoro are all 4.7+; crowded template category with high 4.3 risk, as in abandoned:study-bunny:ads

Mealime (4.8, 53k ratings) shut down on 2026-10-21 with no export, after Albertsons moved it to Meals Hub. Reviews are gone with the listing, so Gate A can't be measured. Killed anyway: the product is a recipe library, and Paprika, AnyList, Plan to Eat, eMeals, Samsung Food, Eat This Much and at least five small new apps are already chasing these users

3M retired the Post-it App (4.7, 13k ratings) on 2026-09-29 with no replacement. Its reviews are gone with the listing and searches found no threads from users, so neither Gate A nor A2 can pass. Miro's Stickies Capture already digitises photographed notes

Night Sky (498k ratings): 34 low-star in 90d (us 31, gb 3) on search moving behind an AI 'Aura' subscription and paywall pop-ups. Needs a sky engine and catalog plus AR compass work; Sky Guide, SkyView and Stellarium already serve the category
round 2 side findings: Apple Notes (49; iOS 27 bugs, not an opportunity), Sticky Widgets (24; widget is the core), Focus Keeper (13)
